policy.accepted_roundoff: divide by observed sum; never clip probabilities
policy.log_loss: natural log; exact zero target probability is positive infinity
policy.tie_break: first option in reference input order; exact ties
policy.invalid_predictions: excluded from conditional quality; unsuccessful in all-example top-choice rate
